name: Eva Payne
reason: Her main work is psilocybin ('earth medicine') retreats and journeys framed around healing, and her own YouTube channel (@IdeasToHumanBetter) is largely psychedelic-healing testimonials with condition-named titles ('Healing Depression & Anxiety through Earth's Medicine', 'Healing After Breast Cancer'); under the strict health rule almost nothing passes. Her site does publish an email (acolorflowlife@gmail.com) and she has a book and non-psychedelic retreats, so the owner may wish to review; her media page also features a conversation with Elena Danaan.
